sections.description:
NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY
NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY
AUTHORITY (NEPRA) SERVICE REGULATIONS, 2003
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II,
19th November, 2012]
S.R.O.1378(I)/2012,
dated 19-11-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred of section 10(1) and
section 47(2) of the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of
Electric Power Act (XL of 1997), the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority
(NEPRA) is pleased to approve
the following amendments
in the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority
(NEPRA) Service Regulations, 2003 (earlier notified vide S.R.O.544(I)/2003,
dated 12-6-2003 and S.R.O. 203(I)/2012, dated 28-2-2012), namely:--
In
the aforesaid Regulations:--
1. Amendment
of regulation 3.-(1) In regulation 3, in sub-regulation (1), the words
"designation wise" shall be omitted.
(2)
In sub-regulation (1)(a), after the words "Regulatory matters" a full
stop shall be inserted and thereafter the remaining sentence shall be
substituted with the following:
"The
detail of sub-cadres which fall in this group shall be:
(i)
Technical:
Consisting of
employees possessing 'Engineering' degree and employed on the posts requiring
such qualification.
(ii)
Tariff:
Consisting of
Chartered and Management Accountants and MBAs and employed on the posts
requiring such qualification.
(iii)
Legal:
Consisting of
employees possessing 'Law' degree and employed on the posts requiring such
qualification.
(iv)
IT:
Consisting of
employees possessing 'Computer Science/Information Technology' degree and
employed on the posts requiring such qualification.
(v)
General:
All other
employees."
(3) In
sub-regulation (I)(b), in the second sentence, the word
"designations" appearing after the words "The details of shall
be substituted by the words "sub-cadres", and the word
"are" appearing after the words "this group" shall be
substituted by the words "shall be the same as".
2. Amendment
of regulation 7.- In regulation 7, the sub-regulation (4) shall be omitted.
3. Amendment
of regulation 11.- Regulation 11 shall be substituted with the following:
"Appointments
to various posts shall be made on an all Pakistan basis in accordance with the
merit and provincial / regional quotas prescribed by the Federal Government for
civil posts from time to time. The posts in each grade shall be considered
separately for the purposes of allocation of prescribed merit and
provincial/regional quotas. The unfilled vacancies reserved for merit and
provincial/regional quotas for which qualified candidates are not available
shall be carried forward except for the posts in NSG-1 grade, which may
otherwise be filled on local basis."
4. Amendment
of regulation 31.-In regulation 31, in sub-regulation (4) "comma"
appearing after the word "suspension" shall be substituted with
"full stop" and remaining sentence to be deleted.
5. Amendment
of regulation 32.-In regulation 32, in sub-regulation (4), the second
sentence starting from "If, however," shall be substituted with the
following:
"In
cases where an employee is called for duty on a closed holiday, he/she should
be allowed off-day in lieu thereof, in the same calendar year. In case the
compensatory leave is not allowed, the employee will be entitled for
compensatory allowance as prescribed by the Authority from time to time."
6. Amendment
of regulation 34.-(1) In regulation 34, in sub-regulation (2) (i), the
figure "60" shall be substituted by "90".
(2)
The sub-regulation (4) shall be substituted with the following:--
"The
Employee will have the option to encash his/her un availed earned leave at
his/her credit at the end of a calendar year or at the time of his/her
retirement."
7. Amendment
of regulation 35.- In regulation 35, at the end of sub-regulation (3), the
following sentence shall be added:
"However,
the maximum number of leaves to be encashed on retirement shall not be more
than 18 months i.e. 540 days."
